description: Servicio de visualización WMS de temporales marítimos is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geoserveis.icgc.cat. WMS service for visualization of orthoimages related to maritime storms. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "WMS view service of maritime storms" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include WMS service, Servicio WMS, Servei WMS. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2022-04-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.icgc.cat/condicions). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
